answer.reason: The verses tell of Jezebel's killing of the LORD's prophets, her plot against Naboth, and her death at Jehu's command.

clauses.english: cut off the prophets of the LORD
clauses.quote: when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD

clauses.english: plotted the stoning of Naboth so that Ahab could take his vineyard
clauses.quote: did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters

clauses.english: was thrown down from a window at Jehu's command and trodden underfoot
clauses.quote: Throw her down. So they threw her down
